<thought>I want a balanced but aggressive core with strong win conditions and defensive glue. Dragonite + Kingambit give two potent sweepers/cleaners, Garchomp adds fast physical pressure and hazards, Gholdengo provides special offense and blocks recovery, Rotom-Wash gives a bulky pivot that covers ground/water weaknesses, and Corviknight provides hazard removal and physical walling. This trio composition can adapt to most matchups at team preview.</thought>

Kingambit
Gholdengo
Garchomp
Rotom-Wash
Corviknight

attempts.reasoning:
Let me pick six strong Pokémon from the legal list. I want good coverage, synergy, and the ability to pick 3 for most matchups. Strong picks: Gholdengo, Kingambit, Dragonite, Garchomp, Rotom-Wash, Corviknight, Annihilape, Meowscarada, Skeledirge, Archaludon, Iron... not available. Let me think about a balanced core.

Team idea: a balanced offensive team with good defensive backbone.- Gholdengo (great offensive, blocks recovery)
- Dragonite (Multiscale sweeper with Dragon Dance)
- Kingambit (late-game cleaner with Sucker Punch)
- Garchomp (fast physical attacker/hazards)
- Rotom-Wash (defensive pivot, helps vs ground types)
- Corviknight (defensive, hazard removal)

That gives good type coverage and strong meta picks. Let me finalize.

attempts.answer:
<thought>The team needs one clear win condition, a reliable hazard plan, speed control, and defensive glue. Dragonite takes Dragoninite as the sole mega for a Dragon Dance sweep backed by Multiscale; Garchomp runs a Focus Sash lead with Stealth Rock and coverage, Kingambit cleans with Supreme Overlord + Black Glasses priority, and Gholdengo is the Nasty Plot breaker that also shuts down opposing Defog/Recover with Good as Gold. Scarf Rotom-Wash with Trick gives the team speed control and cripples walls, while Corviknight holds the Leftovers slot as the Defog/Roost pivot with Body Press to abuse its Defense EVs.</thought>

- Extreme Speed
- Roost

Impish Nature
- Defog
- Roost
- Body Press
- U-turn
</team>
attempts.reasoning:
Build sets. EV limit: max 32 in one stat, 66 total. Nature adds 10% to one stat, -10% another. Note: EVs written as "EVs: 32 Atk / 2 SpD / 32 Spe" — 32 max per stat, 66 total.

Items: unique per Pokémon. Available: Leftovers, Life Orb, Choice Scarf, Choice... only Choice Scarf listed (no Band/Specs). Heavy-Duty Boots not listed. Options: Dragonite — Dragoninite (Mega Dragonite? Actually Dragoninite is listed — allows Mega Evolution once per battle). Hmm, mega stones: Dragoninite exists in this list. Garchompite exists. Kingambit has no mega stone (Kingambite not listed). Gholdengo: Chimechite? That's Chimecho... no. Gholdengo no mega.

Let's decide:
- Dragonite @ Dragoninite (Mega) — Multiscale? If it mega evolves, ability changes presumably. But we can just give Multiscale for pre-mega. Hmm, Mega Dragonite isn't real but in this format it presumably works. Risky but plausible. Alternative: Life Orb on Dragonite. Let's think what's strong. Actually safer: give Dragonite Life Orb? But Life Orb recoil vs Multiscale... Actually many good items. Let's consider:
  - Dragonite: Dragoninite (Mega Dragonite, presumably huge stats) — strong win condition. Or Lum Berry / Life Orb.
  - Garchomp: Garchompite (Mega Garchomp) — strong.
  - Kingambit: Black Glasses (boosts Dark moves Kowtow Cleave/Sucker Punch) or Leftovers.
  - Gholdengo: Life Orb / Spell Tag (boosts Shadow Ball) / Metal Coat (Make It Rain).
  - Rotom-Wash: Leftovers.
  - Corviknight: Leftovers... conflict with Rotom. Options: Sitrus Berry, Rocky Helmet not available... "Hard Stone"? Corviknight: Sharp Beak, Sitrus Berry, Wacan Berry, Coba Berry (weakens Flying), Leftovers.

Let's pick items:
- Dragonite @ Dragoninite, Multiscale, Dragon Dance + Dual... Dragonite moves: Dragon Dance, Earthquake, Extreme Speed, Roost / Fire Punch / Ice Spinner. Classic: DD, EQ, ESpeed, Roost. Adamant/Jolly.
- Garchomp @ Garchompite? But two mega stones on one team — only one can mega evolve per battle per Pokémon? "a Pokémon holding its own Mega Stone can Mega Evolve once per battle" — each Pokémon can mega once per battle, so two mega stones is fine. But Garchomp with Rough Skin + Rocky Helmet... no Rocky Helmet. Garchomp with Soft Sand? Or Focus Sash + Stealth Rock lead: Stealth Rock, Earthquake, Scale Shot/Dragon Claw, Swords Dance/Stone Edge. Let's give Garchomp a lead set with Focus Sash: Stealth Rock, Earthquake, Dragon Claw/Scale Shot, Stone Edge. Actually with Mega Garchompite, Garchomp becomes Mega with Sand Force... Rough Skin lost. Hmm.

Simplify: Dragonite @ Dragoninite (Multiscale), Garchomp @ Focus Sash (Rough Skin) as hazard lead, Kingambit @ Black Glasses (Supreme Overlord), Gholdengo @ Spell Tag or Life Orb (Nasty Plot set), Rotom-Wash @ Leftovers (Will-O-Wisp / Volt Switch / Hydro Pump / Thunder Wave or Pain Split), Corviknight @ Sitrus Berry or Coba Berry or Sharp Beak (Defog, Roost, Brave Bird/Body Press, U-turn/Iron Defense).

Leftovers unique to Rotom. Corviknight: Leftovers would be ideal but taken. Sitrus Berry okay, or "Sharp Beak" for Brave Bird. Let's do Corviknight @ Sitrus Berry... Actually maybe Corviknight Leftovers and Rotom-Wash gets... Rotom-Wash could hold "Magnet" (boosts Electric) or "Mystic Water" (boosts Water) or "Leftovers". Since Rotom is a bulky pivot, Leftovers good. But Corviknight as wall wants Leftovers too. Choose: Corviknight @ Leftovers, Rotom-Wash @ Mystic Water? Hmm, Rotom-Wash often runs Leftovers with Pain Split. Alternatively give Rotom "Wise Glasses" or "Magnet". Let's do Corviknight @ Leftovers and Rotom-Wash @ Magnet? Hydro Pump is its main attack. Actually Give Rotom-Wash "Mystic Water"? Boosts Hydro Pump only. Or "Sitrus Berry" for bulk. Hmm.

Alternative: Corviknight @ Sitrus Berry, Rotom @ Leftovers. Both fine. I'll do Corviknight @ Leftovers... let me decide: Corviknight's job is Defog/Roost wall — Leftovers better. Rotom-Wash can use Pain Split for recovery + "Wise Glasses"? Actually a "Leftovers" Rotom... Let's give Rotom-Wash @ Choice Scarf with Volt Switch/Hydro Pump/Trick/Thunder Wave? That's actually great: Scarf Rotom-W with Trick to cripple walls, Volt Switch, Hydro Pump, Thunderbolt. That frees Leftovers for Corviknight and gives speed control. Nice.

So items:
- Dragonite @ Dragoninite
- Garchomp @ Focus Sash
- Kingambit @ Black Glasses
- Gholdengo @ Life Orb (Nasty Plot, Shadow Ball, Make It Rain, Recover/ Focus Blast)
- Rotom-Wash @ Choice Scarf
- Corviknight @ Leftovers

All unique. Good.

EVs: max 32 per stat, 66 total. Standard spread: 32 Atk / 4 SpD / 32 Spe? That's 68 total — no. Max total 66. So e.g., 32 HP / 32 Def / 2 SpD = 66. Or 32 Atk / 32 Spe / 2 HP = 66.

Natures: allowed freely presumably.

Note the level is 50, and EVs are tiny (max 32), so spreads are simple.

Sets:

Dragonite @ Dragoninite
Ability: Multiscale
EVs: 32 Atk / 2 SpD / 32 Spe  (66 total)
Adamant/Jolly Nature
- Dragon Dance
- Earthquake
- Extreme Speed
- Roost
Adamant for power. But speed ties... 50-level base80. Let's use Jolly? With DD, Adamant fine. Use Adamant.

Actually with 32 Atk / 2 SpD / 32 Spe = 66. Good.

Garchomp @ Focus Sash
Ability: Rough Skin
EVs: 32 Atk / 2 Def / 32 Spe (66)
Jolly Nature
- Stealth Rock
- Earthquake
- Dragon Claw (or Scale Shot)
- Stone Edge / Swords Dance
Lead set: Stealth Rock, Earthquake, Scale Shot, Stone Edge. Scale Shot lowers Def but breaks sash... I'll use Dragon Claw for reliability? Scale Shot is good but 2-5 hits. Let's do: Stealth Rock, Earthquake, Dragon Claw, Stone Edge. Hmm, Swords Dance to pressure. I'll keep coverage: Rock Slide/Stone Edge for flying. Let's use Stone Edge.

Actually with66 total, careful: 32+2+32=66. ✓

Kingambit @ Black Glasses
Ability: Supreme Overlord
EVs: 32 Atk / 32 HP / 2 SpD (66) — or 32 Atk / 32 Spe / 2 HP. Kingambit is slow; Sucker Punch priority. Better bulk: 32 HP / 32 Atk / 2 SpD. Actually Adamant with speed... Kingambit speed 50. Let's do 32 Atk / 32 SpD? Hmm. Standard: HP/Atk/SpD. Do: 32 HP / 32 Atk / 2 SpD, Adamant.
- Swords Dance
- Kowtow Cleave
- Sucker Punch
- Iron Head (for fairy coverage) or Low Kick. Iron Head hits fairies. Kingambit vs fairies needs Iron Head. Set: Swords Dance, Kowtow Cleave, Sucker Punch, Iron Head. ✓

Gholdengo @ Life Orb
Ability: Good as Gold
EVs: 32 SpA / 2 SpD / 32 Spe (66)
Timid Nature (or Modest). Use Timid.
- Nasty Plot
- Shadow Ball
- Make It Rain
- RecoverRecover + Life Orb is a bit anti-synergistic but fine. Alternatively Focus Blast for coverage vs Dark/Normal... Actually Make It Rain and Shadow Ball: Steel/Ghost is resisted by Dark? Ghost resisted by Dark, Steel resisted by Fire/Water/Electric/Steel. Shadow Ball + Make It Rain covers most. Focus Blast hits Kingambit/Dark types... Focus Blast hits Dark. Yes add Focus Blast? But then no recovery. With Life Orb + Recover, use Recover. Hmm, Gholdengo wants Shadow Ball / Make It Rain / Recover / Nasty Plot. That's the standard set. Keep it.

Actually consider dropping Nasty Plot for Focus Blast? No, NP is the win condition. Keep.

Rotom-Wash @ Choice Scarf
Ability: Levitate
EVs: 32 SpA / 2 SpD / 32 Spe (66) — actually scarfed speed control: Timid, 32 Spe.
- Volt Switch
- Hydro Pump
- Thunderbolt / Trick / Thunder Wave
Trick with Scarf is great vs walls. Set: Volt Switch, Hydro Pump, Trick, Thunder Wave? Or Thunderbolt. With Scarf, Thunder Wave conflicts. Let's do: Volt Switch, Hydro Pump, Trick, Thunderbolt. Hmm, Thunder Wave is nice speed control for team. Trick to cripple. I'll do Volt Switch, Hydro Pump, Trick, Thunderbolt.

Wait — but Rotom as "bulky pivot that covers ground/water weaknesses" — Scarf makes it less bulky but still good. Fine. Actually maybe better: give Rotom-W Leftovers and Corviknight... let's keep Scarf Rotom, it gives speed control which team otherwise lacks (Dragonite with DD/EQ speed).

Corviknight @ Leftovers
Ability: Pressure (or Mirror Armor). Mirror Armor is nice; but Pressure is classic for stalling. Use Pressure for stall or Mirror Armor to bounce back Intimidate/stat drops. I'll use Mirror Armor — reflects Intimidate (good for Kingambit? no, for itself) and hazards... Actually Defiant Kingambit wants Intimidate. Corviknight: Mirror Armor reflects Defog? no. Use Pressure.
EVs: 32 HP / 32 Def / 2 SpD (66)
Impish Nature
- Defog
- Roost
- Brave Bird / Body Press
- U-turn / Iron Defense / Taunt
Set: Defog, Roost, Body Press, U-turn. Body Press with Iron Defense would be better but limited slots. Body Press benefits from Defense EVs. Do: Defog, Roost, Body Press, U-turn. Or Brave Bird for damage. Corviknight's Body Press hits Dark/Normal/Steel/Ice/Rock. I'll run Body Press + Iron Defense? Then no U-turn. Given team has Rotom Volt Switch for momentum, Corviknight: Defog, Roost, Body Press, Iron Defense? Might be passive. I'll go Defog, Roost, U-turn, Body Press.

Hmm, since I'm playing this team myself, flexibility is good.

Dragonite: Is Dragoninite legal? It's in the item list. Yes. But if it mega evolves, Dragonite's ability changes (unknown). Multiscale pre-mega is great. Alternatively give Dragonite Life Orb and skip mega. But Garchompite... I only used one mega stone. Maybe give Garchomp Garchompite too? Focus Sash lead is more reliable. I'll keep Dragonite as the mega.

Speed tier considerations at level 50 with32 EVs (≈ 4 points). Fine.

Nature choices: Dragonite Adamant; Garchomp Jolly; Kingambit Adamant; Gholdengo Timid; Rotom Timid; Corviknight Impish.

Team plan thought: mention Dragonite DD mega wincon, Kingambit cleaner, Garchomp SR lead with Sash, Gholdengo NP + Good as Gold blocks Defog/Recovery, Scarf Rotom speed control with Trick, Corviknight Defog/Roost wall.

Wait — Gholdengo blocks recovery of opponents via Good as Gold (blocks status moves like Recover, Defog). Good.
